meta.descriptor: a fast-growing South Shore city across the St. Lawrence from Montreal
meta.fact: home to Quartier DIX30, a lifestyle centre that receives more than 20 million visitors a year

overview: Brossard counted 91,525 residents in the 2021 Census, a 6.8 percent jump from 2016 that outpaced the Quebec average. Those residents live in 35,885 occupied dwellings on just 45.19 square kilometres, making it one of the most densely settled suburbs on Montreal's South Shore.

Retail is the headline: Quartier DIX30, Mail Champlain and boulevard Taschereau draw shoppers from well beyond the city, and three REM stations bring Montreal closer. For a local business, that means heavy foot traffic and new residents, but also direct competition with national chains and destination stores.

byService.lead-generation: Brossard grew 6.8 percent between 2016 and 2021, so lead generation should reach newcomers in REM-area developments quickly, before national chains at DIX30 capture their routine spending.
byService.seo: SEO for a Brossard business must compete with big brands around Quartier DIX30, so bilingual pages aimed at specific sectors and services work better than broad regional terms.
byService.website-development: A Brossard website should be bilingual, fast on mobile and clear about location and parking, since many visitors arrive by car or REM from elsewhere on the South Shore.
byService.branding: Next to the polished national brands that fill DIX30 and Mail Champlain, an independent Brossard business needs branding that feels equally professional while stressing local ownership and service.
